description:
Store one of the client's sample documents (PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 10MB) for a dry run to name by its document_key. Storing it costs nothing; a dry run that reads it may.

A document_url is fetched by this server (public http(s) addresses only, never a private or internal one), then stored.

Needs the key's 'submit' scope, which keys have by default: an upload is a submit's first step.

Args:
  - document_url OR document_base64 (exactly one).
  - file_name (optional): the name to store it under; from the URL when omitted.

Returns: { document_key, file_name, content_type, bytes, next_step }. The type is read from the file's own first bytes, whatever a server or data URL declares.

document_url.description: Publicly fetchable URL of the document

name: handinloop_upload_sample_document
title: Upload a Sample Document
